correctness.rationale: The central idempotent formula gives kernel m chi_r. Endpoint convolution norms equal its L1 mass. Weyl character and integration formulas reduce the problem to I_m=∫_0^pi |sin(m theta)| sin(theta)dtheta. Splitting exactly at all zeros and evaluating a closed antiderivative yields I_m=2m/(m^2-1) cot(pi/(2m)) for m>=2, with m=1 handled separately. The asymptotic follows from the cotangent expansion. A standalone verifier reproduces the signed integral through m=500 and direct quadrature on representative cases; those checks are corroborative only.

value.rationale: A single isotypic Peter--Weyl projection is an atomic spectral object in nonabelian compact harmonic analysis. The exact all-dimension endpoint norm and its linear 8/pi^2 growth quantify instability already at one irreducible block, contrasting with norm-one one-character projections in the abelian case. This is a natural infinite family, not an arbitrary finite slice or table recomputation.
